Severe Weather Warning for Snowy Mountains
warnings.desc: DAMAGING WINDS averaging 80 to 90 km/h may redevelop across alpine areas above 1900 metres early this afternoon before temporarily easing in the evening. Winds will strengthen again before sunrise on Thursday morning and will persist for most of the day. Winds will eventually ease below warning thresholds during Thursday evening. Locations which may be affected include Thredbo Top Station.
